Name: Bethlehem in Zebulun
Description: A town in Zebulun's allotment, named only in the allotment list. It is distinct from Bethlehem in Judah, David's town. The Bethlehem of Ibzan in Judges 12 is debated between Zebulun and Judah, and is not assigned here.
BiblicalSignificance: Bethlehem in Zebulun is an allotment town of the north, not David's Bethlehem.
